description_en: Queries the execution status of backup tasks for a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的备份任务执行情况
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-backup-tasks --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --backup-job-id 11620000 --job-mode Manual --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackupTasks

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query instance IDs
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup task.

If you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473819.html operation to perform a manual backup task, you can set this parameter to the returned backup ID to query the backup progress of the task
parameters.help_zh:
备份任务ID。
如果您调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473819.html执行了手动备份，您可以将返回的备份ID传入，用以查询备份的进度
parameters.name: backup_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated: automatic backup. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473822.html operation to query the automatic backup policy.
Manual: manual backup.

By default, the information about backup tasks in both modes is returned
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式，取值：
Automated：系统自动备份，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473822.html查询自动备份策略。
Manual：手动备份

默认返回所有备份模式的任务信息
parameters.name: job_mode
